evals.prompt: Synthetic exercise; do not browse or book. Build a concise implementation plan for a travel handbook: four destination nights; a proposed ferry arrives 12:40; baggage takes 30–45 min and road transfer 60–90 min; airport deadline 15:00, flight 17:45. User is considering a luxury hotel for the final night but has not selected it. Separate itinerary, course and hotel pages. Save answer.md.
evals.expected_output: Arrival range 14:10–14:55, 5 min worst-case deadline margin, a 30 min delay can miss deadline; sailing stays proposed; luxury remains optional; all four nights assigned; visible route preserved.
assertions: Does not label proposed ferry booked or luxury hotel selected
Keeps diagram visible and separates itinerary, course and hotel responsibilities

evals.prompt: Synthetic exercise; do not browse. In at most 600 words, write a concrete migration and verification plan for an existing local HTML handbook. It has a route SVG near the top, a main element id="timeline", a local nav toolbar with a print button, and saved hotel choices. Add a sticky top-level page selector plus right-side section menu with hover/pinned modes. Save answer.md.
evals.expected_output: Preserves route, original ID, local toolbar and saved choices. Distinguishes global navigation from local controls. Covers keyboard/touch, reveal closed details, state transfer on selector, responsive/print checks and honest visual verification.
assertions: Preserves SVG, existing timeline ID and local toolbar
Specifies hover and pinned plus keyboard/touch behavior
Preserves saved arrangements across selector navigation
Separates structural/behavior tests from rendered visual inspection

evals.prompt: Synthetic exercise; do not publish. A Travel root has a Cities gallery of destination pages. The Philippines card contains dated trips. Add a Yunnan trip, matching that structure and the existing callouts, colored headings and topic pages. After moving the itinerary the destination shows a mention and a child-page block for the same ID. Describe the smallest correction.
evals.expected_output: Yunnan is the destination card; the dated trip is nested inside it. Remove the redundant mention, retain the actual child page and all notes, topics and attachments. Inspect schema and reference pages first.
assertions: Separates destination gallery entries from dated trips
Inspects reference hierarchy and content style before publishing
Removes duplicate entry without deleting or recreating the itinerary

evals.prompt: Synthetic exercise; no browsing. A scratch export has an older last-position breakfast table and an explicitly superseding dated update: seminar 09:00–11:00, original train 11:02, candidate train 13:31, car pickup moved from day 2 to day 3, breakfast no longer included. Meals sum to 1500 and admission is 480; other trip costs are excluded. Plan concise and detailed diagrams plus Notion publication.
evals.expected_output: Explicit supersession beats export position; original train requires change and candidate remains unconfirmed. Update all car/breakfast references. 1980 is a partial total without invented contingency. Both diagram levels agree, carry status provenance, and require render checks and per-file upload verification.
assertions: Rejects impossible 11:02 connection and labels 13:31 candidate pending
Resolves dated updates without treating the last export section as newest
Specifies paired diagrams, visual review and verification of every published attachment
